intent.raw: Refine Lane B (Arcanum inventory + ontology) into a buildable design: confirm the four-layer mapping against real sigil capabilities and design the five bridges (signed register, runtime event-to-card dispatch, 11-rule lint schema, proof-harness, reflection cadence).
intent.objective: Run the canonical refine loop with one Arcanum-capability-surveyor subagent to turn Lane B from a sketch into a buildable design: per-layer mapping to actual sigil capabilities, a reuse-vs-build verdict + MVP + cost for each of the five bridges, and a build order, reusing local Arcanum skill definitions.
intent.operator_sentence: Make Lane B buildable: design the five bridges on top of the Arcanum sigils.

technique_overlays.trigger: The main uncertainty is how each Lane B layer and each of the five bridges maps onto concrete sigil mechanics.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: LANE-B-DESIGN.md emits a concrete per-layer and per-bridge mapping, each traced to a cited Arcanum skill capability path or marked net-new with a reason.

technique_overlays.trigger: The Lane B sketch, prior lane-designer receipts, and local Arcanum skill definitions are material.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Reuse DELIVERY-LANES.md + skill definitions; dedup against the prior Lane B receipt; record residue.

route_menu.context_hint: Single profile: x-ray the bridge mechanics + memory reuse. No competing-design tournament needed (bridges are complementary).

items.label: X-ray the bridges
items.description: Map each layer + bridge to concrete sigil capability; verdict reuse-vs-build.

items.label: Defer Lane B
items.description: Leave Lane B as a sketch until a client picks it; risks under-scoping the offer.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if the Arcanum skill definitions cannot be read.

steps.name: Invoke Define the Lane B build
stop_conditions: Flag if a done-criterion is unaddressed.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Ask before any external pass if a named external gap appears.

steps.name: Distill: map layers + bridges to sigil capabilities
stop_conditions: Block if a layer or bridge cannot map to a cited capability or be marked net-new with a reason.

steps.name: Invoke Redesign to LANE-B-DESIGN.md
stop_conditions: Block if the artifact lacks the layer mapping, the five bridge designs, and a build order.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: Flag any bridge that lacks a decidable build/reuse verdict or MVP.

steps.name: Distill repair
stop_conditions: Block if a flagged gap cannot be repaired or named as residue.

steps.name: Invoke Plan deltas (Lane-B bridges build task)
stop_conditions: Non-executed; flag if deltas are not mapped to existing tasks.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Block if the done-criteria are not concretely satisfied.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Mapping the five Lane B bridges to reuse-vs-build verdicts spans ~8 Arcanum skills beyond the three core ones.
subagent_strategy.explanation: A capability surveyor reads the broader skill surface and returns, per bridge, the best reuse candidate or a net-new verdict, so the design rests on real capabilities instead of guesses.
context: Bridges likely touch inventory lint, observability-setup, observed-invocation-loop, workflow-reflect, schedule, decision-gate, necronomicon, sigil-development.
Lane B's hardest gap is the Layer-2 classification register.

roles.purpose: Survey the candidate Arcanum skills and return, per bridge, a reuse-existing-sigil-vs-net-new verdict with skill path, MVP sketch, and residual gap.
roles.owns: Arcanum capability survey for the five bridges

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run one capability-surveyor subagent to map the five Lane B bridges across the Arcanum skill surface?
receipt_requirements: per-bridge reuse-vs-build verdict with skill path

boundaries.contract: Arcanum skill definitions are read-only capability evidence cited but not modified.
No external research without operator confirmation; default no-research/local-first.

promotion_splits.target: canonical Arcanum knowledge, a new sigil, or client-facing collateral
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and a separate promotion/sigil-development route

gates.condition: Every runtime-backed stage names a canonical capability handle.
Each of the five bridges has a decidable reuse-vs-build verdict, an MVP, and either a cited Arcanum skill path or a net-new reason.
Arcanum skill definitions are read-only; this run must not modify them.
The approved capability-surveyor subagent returns its per-bridge verdicts before parent synthesis.
Outputs are candidates; no canonical promotion, no new sigil install, no pricing/contracts/named clients.
RESULT.md is synthesized from stage artifacts and the subagent receipt and confirms the done-criteria.

promotion_guardrails: Arcanum skill definitions are read-only evidence.
LANE-B-DESIGN.md is a candidate design, not a built system or an installed sigil.
Building the bridges or installing a new sigil is a separate sigil-development/task-session route.
No canonical Arcanum promotion; no pricing/contracts/named clients.
